title: Restore point
intro: A copy of the hub's settings kept on the hub: settings, points, tariffs, time, modules (no tokens). One only: a new one replaces the previous. Save one before big changes.
unknown: Couldn't find out whether there is a restore point.
overwriteBody: The hub already has a restore point. The new one replaces it — the previous can't be brought back.
restoreTitle: Restore settings and restart the hub?
restoreBody: Current settings, points and tariffs are replaced by the saved ones, then the hub restarts (back in 20–30 s). Energy metering isn't interrupted.
restored: Files restored: {n}. The hub is restarting — back in 20–30 s.
failed: The hub didn't do it (no connection?).
restoredNoReboot: Files restored: {n}, but the restart command didn't go. The settings take effect after the hub restarts.
